    Lord of the Fungal Spire: A LitRPG Adventure (The Lone Wanderer Book 5)

    by K. Georgiades aka PathOfPen (Author) Format: Kindle Edition
    4.6 4.6 out of 5 stars (62)
    Book 5 of 6: The Lone Wanderer
    Sorry, there was a problem loading this page.Try again.
    See all formats and editions
    He broke his hunter. He saved his family. Now his soul is the battlefield.

    Percy has done the impossible, creating a     heaven-shaking spell unlike anything Remior has ever seen. His narrow victory freed his grandfather from a cruel enemy’s grasp, but power always demands payment: in this case, his mind, body, and spirit.

    Buried beneath the Fungal Spire with Micky, Percy wakes to tangled thoughts, shattered memories, at the mercy of a colossal wasp looming over them both. The nobles hunting him may have lost his trail, but ancient eyes remain fixed on his every move, and the path ahead leads toward     Soul Tempering, Ancient Secrets, and powers determined to grind him beneath their heels.

    Percy must separate his memories, rescue the people he loves, and defy the heavens even as his own fractured mind threatens to consume him.

    About the author

    Follow authors to get new release updates, plus improved recommendations.

    K. Georgiades aka PathofPen

    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Kyriakos Georgiades grew up playing Metroid and dreaming of exploring the long-forgotten ruins of alien civilizations scattered across the stars. When he realized that 21st-century technology was woefully insufficient to make those dreams a reality, he chose the next best thing: traveling to worlds of his own imagination through the power of his keyboard.

    A good thing he did, too—his cat isn't big on traveling.

    • Lonnie-The GreatNorthernTroll-Moore
      5 out of 5 stars
      Best! Book! Evarrr!
      Reviewed in the United States on 14 August 2026
      Format: Kindle
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I love, Love, LOVE this book! Best Book Evarrr! I know I've said it before, but it's true K. Gorgiades really does Rip out pulse-pounding action adventures! But the first thing Percy and Micky hafta do is wake up and verify that they're Both still alive... and also in the Fungal Spire!!! Not only in the Fungal Spire but in the Starry Queen's Chamber and that Monster Wasp wants to cut a deal with Percy. Which in fact was better, by far than what Percy had hoped for. Percy needed to plant a soul, to make a familiar, into one of the Starry Queen's progeny, an egg. Then Percy has'ta go rescue his Grandfather Archibald, and his Mentor Orin from the prison. All the while sending out clones. So yeah, stories within stories! So many stories that you might even lose track of who's, who. Is it Percy or Micky, and which one is the original? Does it even matter? So yeah AwesomeSauce! Best! Book! Evarrr!

      Go grab the book. Or the series because the next book will be released in just a couple of months!
